summary: An example ansible-navigator.yml shows the settings tree: ansible (config, cmdline such as --forks 15, inventories, playbook), ansible-runner (artifact-dir, rotate-artifacts-count, timeout), app, collection-doc-cache-path and more, all commented out for you to enable.
questions: How do I set the ansible-runner artifact directory in ansible-navigator?
How do I pass --forks through ansible-navigator settings?
